id: # lane/rlfuzz2: the 11 cases lane/rlfuzz left open and every find of rounds 1 to 5 (agent-form fuzzing)

cause: native's dev tp and state refused with 29 to 31 packets queued, a harness limit Java lacks; they now queue to the 1024-packet S2C cap
after a Nether return a chunk the dig machine provided did not reseed its World.rand copy (provideChunk's structure offers); also rf-s1-644
a respawned player kept distanceWalkedModified, distanceWalkedOnStepModified and nextStepDistance, moving the swim step's two draws; also rf-g16-135, rf-g25-234
an overworld spider's target died in the Nether and the overworld's twin of the player kept its old health, so the spider kept a dead target
a Nether traveller's path search provided overworld chunks in the Nether's context; the light read did not load an unloaded neighbour chunk
a player transferred out of the End is placed by no portal and joins no world list; native placed it and started Nether generation
an item merge did not dirty the survivor's tracker entry, and the client's object moves ran their collision query after the placement precheck; not a thread race
an enderman's scream set and reset in one tick dirties its watcher (52fb5f6b relanded); three cr-sweep-gold frames re-measured for the render model's limb swing
a block hit particle's place was computed in float; EffectRenderer.addBlockHitEffects works in double with (double)0.1F
the woken player's place came from a stale position, not the live player
a row may carry as many close ops as clicks; native capped them at 4
an explosion's S27 listed cells: any later write to a listed cell, not only the explosion's own, is what the client applies
a Nether traveller's populate drew the live World.rand instead of the entity pass's per-entity copy
an unlisted player has no tracker entry of its own: no S12, S19, S1C or S20 to itself
window 0's S30 carries the 2x2 crafting grid, which the client applies; also rf-g19-1368
func_82565_a (the path finder's vertical offset) reads the searching entity's own world, not the finder's
a chest over its -z neighbour opens the pair with itself (BlockChest.func_149951_m's z-1 branch)
the client's squid copy moves as EntitySquid does and the ghast copy takes EntityFlying's air branch
the client predicts a sneaking placement against a chest; native excluded chests
a traveller that dies in the tick it transfers is placed by no portal and not spawned in the destination
setSprinting marks the attributes dirty only when the sprint modifier moves (also the four knockback sites)
a child copy's move starts from the box setScaleForAge left
a placement's block callbacks (a torch that pops) drew the live World.rand, not the placement case's stream (4 draws short); also rf-g17-1756, rf-g21-1760
an arrow's travel copy is 0.5 by 0.5 (EntityArrow(World)), not the shooter constructor's 0.6 by 1.8
a dead player's container screen closed before the row's clicks (vanilla: handleInput, then updateScreen); the respawned player's window ids did not start over

an ageing child's growing age (DataWatcher 12) changes every tick, so its tracker entry updates every tick; native's watched values lacked the age, the client's chick copy lagged and the mouseover took it instead of the dug block (no hit particle)
an unloaded animal saved without a "Random spawn bonus" (an egg's hatchling) came back with a zero one: the resaved record now notes its absence (g16-1995 row 305)
a reloaded child animal kept the adult box: readEntityFromNBT's setGrowingAge scales it and readFromNBT's tail setPosition re-centres it (g16-1995 row 306)
